title: Inversion enfatica y estructuras de enfasis

lesson.intro: La inversion consiste en poner el auxiliar antes del sujeto (como en una pregunta) despues de ciertos elementos al principio de la frase: adverbios negativos, Not only, No sooner, Only then, o Had / Were / Should en condicionales. Es un recurso de registro formal, literario o dramatico que anade enfasis.

sections.heading: 1 - Inversion tras adverbios negativos
sections.body:
Si la frase empieza por un adverbio o expresion negativa o restrictiva (Never, Rarely, Seldom, Little, Nowhere, Not until, At no time, Under no circumstances, Not once), el verbo se invierte: adverbio + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

En presente / pasado simple se anade do / does / did.
examples: Never have I seen such a thing.
Rarely does he complain.
Little did she know the truth.
Under no circumstances should you open that door.

sections.heading: 2 - Not only... but also
sections.body:
Para destacar dos puntos (a menudo sorprendentes). La primera parte lleva inversion: Not only + auxiliar + sujeto..., but ... also...

but also se puede reducir a but ... too / as well.
examples: Not only did she pass, but she also got the top mark.
Not only was he late, but he forgot the tickets.
Not only did they buy the house, but they redecorated it.

sections.heading: 3 - No sooner / Hardly / Scarcely
sections.body:
Para decir que una cosa paso justo despues de otra en el pasado.

  • No sooner + had + sujeto + participio + than...
  • Hardly / Scarcely + had + sujeto + participio + when...

Ojo con la conjuncion: No sooner... than; Hardly / Scarcely... when.
examples: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
Hardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
Scarcely had they got home when the storm broke.

sections.heading: 4 - Only + inversion
sections.body:
Si la frase empieza por Only then / Only after / Only when / Only by / Only if / Only in..., la clausula principal lleva inversion (no la de only).

Excepcion: Only + sujeto (Only Maria noticed) no invierte.
examples: Only then did I understand.
Only by working hard can you succeed.
Only if you apologise will I forgive you.

sections.heading: 5 - Inversion en condicionales
sections.body:
Alternativa formal a if: se omite if y se invierte.

  • If I had known → Had I known
  • If I were you → Were I you
  • If you should need → Should you need

Negativa: Had I not known / Were it not for...
examples: Had you told me, I would have come.
Should you have any questions, please contact us.
Were I in your position, I'd resign.
Had she not left early, she would have seen it.

sections.heading: 6 - So / Such / Neither / Nor + inversion
sections.body:
• So + adjetivo/adverbio + that + resultado; con inversion: So loud was the noise that...
  • Such + (a/an) + sustantivo + that; con inversion: Such was the demand that...
  • Acuerdo: So + auxiliar + sujeto (So do I) tras afirmativa; Neither / Nor + auxiliar + sujeto (Neither do I) tras negativa.
examples: So tired was I that I fell asleep.
"I love jazz." "So do I."
"I can't drive." "Neither can I."

sections.heading: 7 - Enfasis con 'do' y fronting
sections.body:
'do' enfatico: do / does / did + verbo base para insistir: I do like it; She did call; Do sit down.

Fronting: mover una parte al principio para dar enfasis o contraste: This film I really enjoyed; Down came the rain.

Otros: the very, at all, whatsoever, y las estructuras enfaticas It was X that... / What ... is ....
examples: I do apologise.
That mistake I will never forget. (fronting)
It was you who did it.
What I want is some peace.

sections.heading: 8 - Transformar a la forma con inversion
sections.body:
Pasos:

  1. Identifica el elemento que va al principio (adverbio negativo, Only..., Not only..., Had / Were / Should).
  2. Detras pon el auxiliar (o do/does/did en simple; had en past perfect).
  3. Luego el sujeto y el resto.

Recuerda: Only + sujeto no invierte.
examples: I have never seen it. → Never have I seen it.
We only realised then. → Only then did we realise.
If I had known... → Had I known...

contrast.title: Con inversion o sin ella
rows: She had hardly left when it rained.
Hardly had she left when it rained.

mistakes: NO: Never I have seen this. -> SI: Never have I seen this.
NO: No sooner I had left when... -> SI: No sooner had I left than...
NO: Hardly had we arrived than... -> SI: Hardly had we arrived when...
NO: Only then I realised. -> SI: Only then did I realise.
NO: Not only he lied, but... -> SI: Not only did he lie, but...
NO: If had I known... -> SI: Had I known... (se quita 'if')
NO: "I'm tired." "So I am." (eso significa 'en efecto lo estoy') -> Para acuerdo: "So am I."

questions.prompt: Never ___ such a thing.
questions.explanation: Adverbio negativo al principio -> auxiliar + sujeto.

questions.prompt: Rarely ___ so quiet.
Cuando un adverbio negativo abre la frase, usamos:
Seldom ___ a more boring film.
Little ___ that he was being followed.
Nowhere ___ such kindness.
Not until midnight ___ home.
Under no circumstances ___ the door.
'At no time ___ aware of the danger.'
Esta estructura se usa en:
questions.explanation: No es habitual en el habla cotidiana.

questions.prompt: En presente simple, la inversion necesita:
'Rarely he goes out.' Correccion:
'Not once ___ to apologise.'
Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the tickets.
'Not only... but also' con inversion enfatiza:
options: que hay dos puntos (a menudo sorprendentes)
questions.answer: que hay dos puntos (a menudo sorprendentes)

questions.prompt: Not only ___ the exam, she got the top mark.
Not only ___ rude, but he was dishonest too.
La inversion va en:
questions.explanation: La segunda clausula lleva orden normal (+ also).

questions.prompt: Completa: Not only ___ (he / lie), but he also cheated.
Not only ___ the money, they demanded an apology.
'Not only she sings, but she dances.' Correccion:
options: Not only does she sing, but she also dances.
questions.answer: Not only does she sing, but she also dances.
questions.explanation: Inversion con 'does' en la primera parte.

questions.prompt: 'but also' se puede reducir a:
questions.explanation: El 'also' se puede desplazar o cambiar.

questions.prompt: Not only ___ the house, but they redecorated it.
Not only ___ tired, I was also hungry.
Cual es correcta y enfatica?
options: Not only did he apologise, but he also paid for the damage.
Not only he apologised, but he paid.
questions.answer: Not only did he apologise, but he also paid for the damage.
questions.explanation: Inversion en la primera parte, 'also' en la segunda.

questions.prompt: No sooner ___ the door than the phone rang.
'No sooner...' va seguido de:
'Hardly...' y 'Scarcely...' van seguidos de:
Hardly ___ when it started to rain.
Estas estructuras describen:
options: una cosa justo despues de otra (en el pasado)
questions.answer: una cosa justo despues de otra (en el pasado)

questions.prompt: El tiempo verbal de la primera clausula suele ser:
Completa: No sooner ___ (I / sit down) than someone knocked.
Scarcely ___ home when the storm broke.
'No sooner had I left than...' significa:
'Hardly had the film started ___ the lights went out.'
Equivalente sin inversion de 'No sooner had I arrived than she left':
options: As soon as I arrived, she left.
questions.answer: As soon as I arrived, she left.
questions.explanation: 'As soon as' expresa la misma inmediatez.

questions.prompt: No sooner ___ the news than she burst into tears.
Hardly ___ a word all evening.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly' (= apenas) al principio -> did + sujeto + base.

questions.prompt: Only then ___ what she meant.
questions.explanation: Only then + did + sujeto + base (en la principal).

questions.prompt: Only after the meeting ___ the mistake.
questions.explanation: Only after... -> inversion en la principal.

questions.prompt: 'Only when' / 'Only after' / 'Only by' al principio provocan:
options: inversion en la clausula de tiempo
questions.explanation: La clausula de 'only' va en orden normal.

questions.prompt: Only by working together ___ succeed.
Only if you apologise ___ forgive you.
questions.explanation: Only if... -> inversion en la principal.

questions.prompt: Only recently ___ the truth.
Completa: Only after she left ___ (I / realise) I loved her.
En 'Only when it was too late did he act', la inversion esta en:
questions.explanation: La subordinada de tiempo va normal.

questions.prompt: Only in an emergency ___ this number.
'Only then I realised.' Correccion:
Only after checking twice ___ satisfied.
Only Sarah ___ the answer.
Cual necesita inversion?
options: Only later did we find out.
questions.answer: Only later did we find out.

questions.prompt: 'Had I known, I would have helped' equivale a:
3er condicional invertido: sustituye 'if' poniendo ___ delante.
'___ you need anything, just ask.' (= If you should need)
'___ I in your position, I'd resign.' (= If I were)
Los condicionales invertidos son:
options: mas formales que las clausulas con 'if'
questions.answer: mas formales que las clausulas con 'if'

questions.prompt: 'Had she not left early, she ___ the accident.'
questions.explanation: 3er condicional: would have + participio en la principal.

questions.prompt: 'Should you have any questions, ___ contact us.'
questions.explanation: La clausula principal puede ser un imperativo educado.

questions.prompt: La negativa de 'Had I known' es:
questions.explanation: En la inversion formal el 'not' va tras el sujeto.

questions.prompt: 'Were it not for your help, I ___ failed.'
questions.explanation: 'Were it not for...' = 'If it weren't for...'; resultado: would have + participio.

questions.prompt: 'If I were rich' con inversion = '___ I rich'.
'Should you change your mind, let me know' significa:
questions.explanation: Should + sujeto = condicion poco probable / educada.

questions.prompt: Cual es un condicional invertido correcto?
So ___ was the noise that we couldn't sleep.
Such ___ that the tickets sold out in minutes.
questions.explanation: Such + sustantivo (invertido: Such was the demand that...).

questions.prompt: 'So + adjetivo' se combina con:
'Such + sustantivo' se combina con:
'I love jazz.' - 'So ___ I.'
questions.explanation: So + auxiliar (do) + sujeto = acuerdo con una afirmativa.

questions.prompt: 'I can't swim.' - 'Neither ___ I.'
'She won't come.' - '___ will he.'
questions.explanation: Tras una negativa se usa Neither / Nor.

questions.prompt: 'They were late.' - 'So ___ we.'
'So do I' expresa:
'Neither do I' expresa:
So beautiful ___ the view that we stopped the car.
'He didn't call. ___ did she.'
questions.explanation: Tras una negativa -> Neither / Nor + auxiliar + sujeto.

questions.prompt: 'So + auxiliar + sujeto' = '... tambien'; 'Neither + auxiliar + sujeto' =
'I do love this song.' Aqui 'do' es:
'She did tell you, I heard her.' 'did' anade:
questions.explanation: Se usa para rebatir o insistir.

questions.prompt: El 'do' enfatico va seguido de:
'Do sit down!' El 'Do' hace la peticion:
questions.explanation: 'Do' + imperativo suaviza y refuerza la invitacion.

questions.prompt: El 'fronting' consiste en:
options: mover una parte al principio para dar enfasis o contraste
questions.answer: mover una parte al principio para dar enfasis o contraste
questions.explanation: Se destaca lo que se adelanta.

questions.prompt: 'This book I really enjoyed.' El objeto se adelanta para:
questions.explanation: Se contrasta con otros libros, por ejemplo.

questions.prompt: 'Down came the rain.' Este adelantamiento de un adverbial es tipico de:
'The very thing I need' - 'the very' anade:
'I have no idea whatsoever.' 'whatsoever' intensifica:
'not ... at all' sirve para:
'It was John who broke it' pone el foco en:
'What I need is a holiday.' Esta estructura enfatiza:
questions.explanation: El elemento tras 'is' recibe el foco.

questions.prompt: Reescribe de forma enfatica: 'I have never been so embarrassed.'
options: Never have I been so embarrassed.
Never I have been so embarrassed.
questions.answer: Never have I been so embarrassed.

questions.prompt: Reescribe: 'She had hardly sat down when the bell rang.'
options: Hardly had she sat down when the bell rang.
questions.answer: Hardly had she sat down when the bell rang.

questions.prompt: Reescribe: 'If you had told me, I would have come.'
options: Had you told me, I would have come.
questions.answer: Had you told me, I would have come.
questions.explanation: Se quita 'if' e invierte: Had + sujeto + participio.

questions.prompt: Reescribe: 'We only realised the truth then.'
options: Only then did we realise the truth.
Only then we realised the truth.
Only then realised we the truth.
questions.answer: Only then did we realise the truth.

questions.prompt: Reescribe: 'He is not only talented but also modest.'
options: Not only is he talented, but he is also modest.
questions.answer: Not only is he talented, but he is also modest.
questions.explanation: Inversion en la clausula de 'Not only'.

questions.prompt: Detecta el error: 'Never I have seen such a mess.'
questions.explanation: Tras 'Never' inicial se invierte auxiliar y sujeto.

questions.prompt: Detecta el error: 'No sooner I had left when it rained.'
options: 'No sooner had I left THAN it rained' (inversion + 'than')
questions.answer: 'No sooner had I left THAN it rained' (inversion + 'than')
questions.explanation: No sooner + had + sujeto + participio + than.

questions.prompt: Reescribe con 'So': 'It rained heavily, so the match was cancelled.'
options: So heavily did it rain that the match was cancelled.
questions.answer: So heavily did it rain that the match was cancelled.
questions.explanation: So + adverbio + did + sujeto + base + that.

questions.prompt: 'Should you need help' significa lo mismo que:
La inversion enfatica aparece sobre todo en:
questions.explanation: Es un recurso de registro alto.

questions.prompt: Cual mantiene el orden normal (SIN inversion)?
El auxiliar de una inversion concuerda con:
options: el sujeto y el tiempo verbal original
questions.answer: el sujeto y el tiempo verbal original
questions.explanation: Si la frase era 'have + participio', se usa 'have/has'; si era simple, 'do/does/did'.
